style: Cinematic surreal dream photograph in wide 16:9 composition, soft ethereal haze like pads of glowing light, shallow depth of field, impossible dreamlike scale, deep ink-blue and teal night tones with warm sodium-amber light, fine film grain, glass reflections, a recurring glowing amber ribbon of magnetic tape, no text, no letters, people only seen from behind or as silhouettes with no visible face.
